start.text: This investigation has been concluded to my satisfaction. I suggest you move along.

choices.text: I have questions about the Harrington case.
I know about the payment, Constable.

harrington_case.text: Natural causes, pending full examination. Nothing suspicious. The family concurs.

choices.text: Natural causes, with a forced desk drawer.

desk_challenge.text: Details of ongoing investigations are confidential. I'd thank you not to interfere with police business.

choices.text: I'm trying to solve a murder.
Someone paid you to look the other way.

murder_word.text: Murder. That is a strong word. You'd better have evidence before you throw it around.

bribe_confrontation.text: You are playing a very dangerous game. I would strongly advise you to drop this enquiry.

choices.text: How much did Lady Harrington pay you?

threat_or_warning.text: It is professional courtesy. Now get out of this office.

choices.text: I'll be back with the Inspector.
How much did she pay you?

how_much.text: I have absolutely no idea what you are talking about. This conversation is finished.

receipt_confrontation.text: ... Where did you — that is stolen evidence. I will have you arrested for this.

webb_cornered.text: Thirty pounds. That is all it was. I was told it was a domestic dispute — I did not know anyone was dead until after.

choices.text: You have a chance to do the right thing now.
That is for the Inspector to decide.

webb_cooperates.text: Fine. I will write a statement. Lady Harrington approached me directly. I want that on record — I did not know the full extent of it.

choices.text: I will do what I can. Good day.

quick_conclusion.text: Efficiency is a virtue in this office.

choices.text: You were on the scene for fifteen minutes.
The family must have been very grateful.
The family appreciated the discretion, I'm sure.

family_agreement.text: The widow is bereaved. Of course she was grateful for a swift resolution.

gathering_evidence.text: Then come back when you have it. Until that time this office is closed to you.

inspector_threat.text: Be my guest. The Inspector will hear about your obstruction at the same time.

webb_shuts_down.text: OUT. Now. Or I arrest you for harassment of a serving officer.
